capitalVsInterest.title: Where each instalment goes

balance.title: What you still owe
balance.description: What you still owe, from the first instalment to the last.

byYear.title: Cost each year
byYear.description: Interest and capital repaid in each calendar year.

lifetimeSplit.title: What the loan costs in total
lifetimeSplit.description: Interest as a share of everything you repay.

breakEven.title: When you come out ahead
breakEven.description: Total spent so far, with and without overpaying.

interestHeatmap.title: Interest month by month
interestHeatmap.description: Darker means more interest. Rate resets show up as steps.
